description: This file implements a SOCKS proxy with client certificate injection for Playwright, handling TLS handshake modifications, ALPN parsing, and proxy connection management.

classes.name: SocksProxyConnection
classes.description: Manages individual SOCKS proxy connections, handling TLS and plaintext tunnels, and protocol detection.

classes.name: ClientCertificatesProxy
classes.description: Main class managing SOCKS proxy with client certificates, secure contexts, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: loadDummyServerCertsIfNeeded
methods.description: Loads self-signed dummy server certificates if not already loaded.

methods.name: normalizeOrigin
methods.description: Normalizes origin strings to URL origin format.

methods.name: convertClientCertificatesToTLSOptions
methods.description: Converts client certificate data into TLS options for secure context creation.

methods.name: getMatchingTLSOptionsForOrigin
methods.description: Retrieves TLS options matching a specific origin based on configured client certificates.

methods.name: rewriteToLocalhostIfNeeded
methods.description: Rewrites host 'local.playwright' to 'localhost' for TLS context purposes.

methods.name: rewriteOpenSSLErrorIfNeeded
methods.description: Rewrites specific OpenSSL errors into more descriptive messages.

methods.name: parseALPNFromClientHello
methods.description: Parses ALPN protocols from a TLS ClientHello buffer.

methods.name: parseALPNExtension
methods.description: Parses ALPN extension data from a ClientHello extension block.
